Title: Family of Adventurers on a Remote Island

Description: A family of five living on a remote island. The father has a rugged appearance with a beard and wears earth-toned explorer attire. The mother is gentle, dressed in a modest, light-colored dress. They have three sons: a tall teenager and two younger boys. All three boys are sun-tanned with messy hair, dressed in simple linen shirts with rolled-up sleeves, shorts, and are barefoot, embodying a practical survivalist style.

Three original cartoon characters: a round, cheerful brown bear with a curious personality; a small, energetic pink pig who is easily startled; a tall, calm donkey with a thoughtful and analytical personality. Flat modern cartoon illustration, warm colors, playful facial expressions, honey jars, forest paths, family-friendly educational tone. Original character designs, not based on any existing fictional characters.

Original grimdark science-fantasy characters:
heavily armored space-knight warriors carrying banners, relics, and futuristic weapons.
Gothic starship cathedrals, ruined alien battlefields, incense smoke, braziers, and stained glass.
Battle-worn metal, dramatic cinematic lighting, black, gunmetal, crimson, parchment, and gold.
Epic solemn military atmosphere. Original character and world designs, not based on any existing fictional franchise.
